scope: B1 frozen ROSS element reference reproduction; policy established before any native B1 comparison
comparison: Every entry independently: abs(candidate-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference). No global matrix norm sets an absolute tolerance.
zero_pattern_policy: Exact numerical zero/nonzero mask for every primary matrix and lateral selection. Sign of floating zero is recorded by byte comparison but is not a physical discrepancy.
serialization_policy: Frozen NPY file bytes and raw F-order values are hash-protected. Cross-platform numerical agreement is a separate gate; different candidate serialization bytes alone do not fail numerical reproduction.

dimensional_interpretation.coordinates: x,y,z in m; alpha,beta,theta in rad (dimensionless in SI)
dimensional_interpretation.M_G_Kst: Generalized inertial coefficients: translation/translation kg; translation/rotation kg*m; rotation/rotation kg*m^2. G multiplies spin and velocity; Kst multiplies angular acceleration and displacement.
dimensional_interpretation.K: Generalized stiffness: translation/translation N/m; translation/rotation N; rotation/rotation N*m. No comparisons mix these entries through a common absolute norm.
dimensional_interpretation.load_additions: Same entry units as K, restricted to the lateral selection; subtraction roundoff is bounded entrywise from the corresponding loaded and unloaded reference entries, never from the axial stiffness.

shaft_M_lateral.units: kg / kg*m / kg*m^2 by row and column
shaft_M_lateral.reason: 4096 epsilon, reserved for scalar polynomial evaluation/reordering in these finite reviewed fixtures; exact zeros checked separately.

shaft_M_axial.reason: 512 epsilon for the short endpoint-mean consistent-mass expression.

shaft_M_torsional.reason: 512 epsilon for endpoint-mean torsional inertia; not scaled by translational mass.

shaft_K_lateral.units: N/m / N / N*m by row and column
shaft_K_lateral.reason: 4096 epsilon for scalar bending/shear/preload arithmetic; each small torque entry is tested against its own value.

shaft_K_axial.reason: 512 epsilon for EAe/L; this block cannot set the tolerance of other blocks.

shaft_K_torsional.reason: 512 epsilon for Gs*Je/L, independently of axial stiffness.

shaft_axial_load_addition.reason: Compare S20/S21 minus S02. Add the predetermined bound 16*epsilon*(abs(K_loaded_ref_ij)+abs(K_base_ref_ij)) for cancellation in subtracting two matrices. This is not a globally scaled tolerance.

shaft_torque_addition.reason: Compare S22/S23 minus S02, signed. Use the same entrywise subtraction floor; torque entries absent from the baseline retain a small local bound.

shaft_G.units: kg / kg*m / kg*m^2 by row and column
shaft_G.reason: 4096 epsilon for scalar gyroscopic coefficients; exact skew/zero patterns independently audited.

shaft_Kst.units: kg / kg*m / kg*m^2 by row and column
shaft_Kst.reason: 4096 epsilon for angular-acceleration coefficients; nonsymmetry and flag independence retained.

disk_M.units: kg on translation diagonal; kg*m^2 on rotation diagonal
disk_M.reason: Direct input assignments, not an iterative or polynomial calculation.

disk_G.reason: Only +Ip/-Ip direct assignments at the two specified entries.

derived_metadata.reason: 256 epsilon for constructor-derived scalar quantities; input specification, keys, flags, names and DOF maps must match exactly.

limitation: These pre-native engineering bounds apply to the declared finite B1 fixtures. They are not a proof of uniform floating-point conditioning for arbitrary degenerate geometry. A future failure requires diagnosis, not automatic tolerance relaxation.
